summary: Ocala National Forest site in Marion County FL; tower removed in the 1940s or 1950s, footings and perimeter poles remain; registered 2016.

facts.status_note: Removed in the 1940s or 1950s. Footings and perimeter poles remain in Ocala National Forest.

visit.trail_note: A witness post stands along nearby Forest Road 9. No source describes access to the site.

events.note: Register gives only '1940s or 1950s'; 1950 is a placeholder year, not a sourced date
Registered July 24, 2016; nominated by Robert Spear

evidence.quote: Footings remain from this former fire tower in Ocala National Forest.

notes_for_editor: Every tower fact rests on one register entry (FFLOS); Forest Lookouts adds only the county. No build date, design source, staffing, fire history or access description was found. The 1950 removal year is a placeholder for '1940s or 1950s'. Two searches and several page reads found nothing else for this site. Wikipedia is used only for the community's location, not the tower.
